annotations.title: Dimensional weight and billable weight calculator

description: Dimensional weight and billable weight calculator — Billable shipping weight for a box across UPS, FedEx, DHL Express, Amazon FBA and USPS: rounds each side, applies the carrier divisor (139, USPS 166 over 1 cubic foot), compares with actual weight and says which one is billed. Adds length+girth, Additional Handling / Large Package / oversize flags, freight density and an estimated NMFC density class, and how much 1-2 inches less box height would save. Params: length=, width=, height= (inches, or unit=cm), weight= (lb, or weight_unit=kg), optional qty=. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_dim_weight
